headline: Still Waiting on a Call Back From Your Property Manager?
body: Full Scope Home Services answers — that's the whole pitch. Real people, real updates on repairs and applications, without you having to chase anyone down. Free rental analysis, no obligation.
audience: Owners currently frustrated with their existing property manager
creative: Photo of the actual local manager (e.g. Brandon) mid-call, or a clean text graphic built around Scott W.'s review.
grounding: Scott W.'s testimonial contrasts Full Scope directly with an "impersonal" prior manager — this is close to a direct quote.

headline: What Could Your Rental Actually Be Earning?
body: Get a free, no-pressure rental analysis from a local St. Louis property manager. Find out what your property could rent for — and what it's really costing you to manage it yourself.
audience: Self-managing landlords and owners comparing PM companies
creative: Clean exterior photo of a well-kept St. Louis-area rental, or a simple calculator/clipboard graphic.
grounding: Matches the "Free Rental Analysis" CTA already live on fullscopehomes.com — the category-standard offer, confirmed by 4 of the 5 competitors researched.

headline: Your Property Manager Shouldn't Be a Profit Center for Contractors
body: One owner told us her maintenance estimates dropped significantly the day she switched to us. We manage repairs like it's our own money — because keeping your property profitable is the actual job.
audience: Owners currently paying for management, cost-sensitive
creative: Before/after repair photo, or a text-forward graphic built around Katherine S.'s quote (with her permission to use it in an ad).
grounding: Direct line from Katherine S.'s testimonial: "Their maintenance estimates are significantly lower than my prior property managers."

headline: Meet the Person Who'll Actually Manage Your Property
body: No call centers. No rotating account reps. Just a local team that knows St. Louis rentals and treats your property like it's the only one we manage.
platform: Instagram + Facebook, hyper-local St. Louis/St. Charles geo targeting
audience: Owners tired of large/impersonal management companies
creative: Real photo or short video of the team on-site at a property — needs your dad to supply footage.
grounding: Scott W.'s testimonial names Brandon directly and contrasts him with a prior company where "nobody there had a name."

headline: Take 60 Seconds: Is It Time to Switch Property Managers?
body: Answer a few quick questions about communication, maintenance costs, and vacancy time. If it looks like it's time for a change, we'll send your free rental analysis.
audience: Owners not actively searching, but open to the idea
creative: Simple quiz-style creative: checklist icon, progress bar, no video needed.
grounding: Combines every pain point found in this research (communication, cost, vacancy) into one qualifying format — no local competitor is running anything like this.
